text:
Marina S.: inbound from Montara — invoice  INV-2026-0043 is on hold for VAT reverse-charge, says 'missing resale certificate'. customer uploaded a PDF but our billing UI still shows no proof. can someone check webhook/delivery?

Felix B.: saw the hold. customer claim: file uploaded via portal at 2026-03-12T09:14Z. portal returned 200. billing-bot shows a 410 on the webhook to /payments/attachments. attaching bot logs below.

billing-bot: webhook deliver failed to /payments/attachments for invoice INV-2026-0043 -> status 410 Gone, response: {"error":"attachment no longer available"} :warning:

Nadia P.: 410 usually means S3 presigned link expired before our worker fetched it. portal should hand off attachment to storage on upload, but it looks like we stream through short-lived links. can we re-run fetch?

Saanvi K.: customer says they uploaded a 1.6MB PDF/A (signed). they also have PO: PO-9987 referencing "Montara Europe AG" while legal name in VAT ID is "Montara GmbH" — possible name mismatch flagged by compliance check.

Marina S.: here's the webhook payload we logged (sanitized):
```
{
  "invoice_id":"INV-2026-0043",
  "uploader":"montara_portal_user_42",
  "attachment_url":"https://internal-upload.example/signed/abcd?expires=1700000000",
  "tax_exemption":true,
  "vat_id":"DE123456789"
}
```

Felix B.: note expires param — 1700000000 was in the past when our fetcher retried. fetcher retries are queued, we need longer TTL or immediate push. SRE/ingest should review.

Nadia P.: temporary mitigation: if we can get the file re-uploaded or customer to re-share a direct link, billing team can manually attach it to the invoice and run compliance check. can we request manual override if compliance accepts?

Legal Ops: we need to confirm that the resale certificate matches the VAT ID and legal entity. PO name mismatch will block reverse-charge until manual review. if the PDF contains company registration or letterhead showing the linked VAT ID, that's usually sufficient. please upload the full PDF (not a screenshot) and include the registration number.

Marina S.: requested re-upload, asked customer to use the 'attach to invoice' flow again and to include a short note: "reg number: HRB12345". also asked them to avoid zip files. i've given them a curl example to push the file: 

```bash
curl -X POST 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PORTAL_TOKEN" 
  -F "file=@resale_cert.pdf" 
  "https://portal.redwood.example/api/v1/invoices/INV-2026-0043/attachments"
```

Saanvi K.: adding: customer reported an earlier 502 from our attachments service around 09:16Z which probably caused the portal to roll back to temp link and expire. i can escalate to eng-infra.

Felix B.: action items: (1) Nadia — can you run a manual fetch attempt if customer re-uploads and post resulting checksum? (2) Saanvi — escalate 502 -> attachments SLO; we need increased link TTL while portal backend is flaky. (3) Legal Ops — standby for manual entity check if name mismatch persists.

Nadia P.: will do manual fetch once they re-upload. if we still get 4xx we'll request a direct S3 copy from portal team.

billing-bot: invoice INV-2026-0043 status changed: on_hold -> pending_manual_review (trigger: manual_attachment_pending)

Marina S.: customer re-uploaded at 09:44Z, link now valid. attaching log snippet:
```
GET /internal-upload/abcd -> 200 OK, content-type: application/pdf, sha256: 3f7a9b...
```

Nadia P.: fetched file, checksum matches, forwarded to Legal Ops for name/VAT cross-check.

Legal Ops: checked PDF — contains company letterhead "Montara GmbH" and tax reg HRB12345, VAT DE123456789. PO name is a procurement alias; acceptable. i approve reverse-charge for INV-2026-0043.

Felix B.: applied manual exemption flag and released invoice for payment. invoicing system note: manual_reverse_charge_override by felix_b at 2026-03-12T10:12Z.

Marina S.: customer notified and confirmed payment processed. closing thread. :white_check_mark:

Saanvi K.: follow-up ticket for eng-infra to extend presigned URL TTL when attachments service returns 5xx during upload: TKT-2421.

Marina S.: thanks everyone, recommend we add a small checklist to support docs for these cases (what file info to request from customers) to speed resolution next time.
